description: DTDL v2 schema for the temperature, voltage, and fanspeed MetricTypes documented in docs/Metrics/04_ONBOARD_SENSOR_FIELDS.md. All three are platform-dependent (e.g. Advantech SUSI). Temperature supports v1.1 Sensor Expansion via Parameters.Source / Parameters.Sources; expanded sensors share the Temperature Telemetry DTMI and differentiate by ResourceId suffix at publish time.

schemas.description: Allowed MetricType discriminators in this Interface.

Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when MetricType == 'temperature'. v1.1 recommends 'therm' with the source moved to Parameters.Source / Parameters.Sources. v1.0-compatible MetricName values (any hardware source name, e.g. 'cpU-therm') are accepted but not enumerated here -- validators must allow MetricName to be 'therm' or any non-empty string.
Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when MetricType == 'voltage'.
Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when MetricType == 'fanspeed'.
Allowed values of SensorGroup. Temperature uses 'TEMP'; voltage uses 'PWR'; fanspeed uses 'SYS'.
Allowed values of SensorInfo.Schema. For every metric in this Interface the value is 'double'.

contents.name: Temperature
contents.description: Onboard thermal sensor reading in Celsius. MetricType=temperature, MetricName=therm (v1.1) or source name (v1.0 compat). v1.1 expansion: one published sample per Parameters.Source (single) or Parameters.Sources (array / auto-detect); ResourceId is suffixed with the source name.
contents.comment: Validation: -40.0 <= v <= 125.0 realistic; reject NaN / +-Inf as sensor faults; null/suppressed when the source name is missing from the driver-supplied dictionary or hardware returns null. Pair with ThermalProtectionIsSupported (see HardwareFeature interface) -- without thermal protection the host has no autonomous over-temperature response.

contents.name: Voltage
contents.description: Onboard voltage-rail reading in volts. MetricType=voltage, MetricName=voltage. v1.x publishes the aggregate of all rails as a single sensor; per-rail discrimination is reserved for a future release (planned: a Source/Sources parameter mirroring Temperature).
contents.comment: Validation: rail-specific bounds applied downstream (e.g. VCORE in [0.6, 1.5], +5V in [4.75, 5.25]); reject NaN / +-Inf; null/suppressed on unsupported hosts.

contents.name: FanSpeed
contents.description: Onboard fan speed reading in RPM. MetricType=fanspeed, MetricName=fanspeed. v1.x publishes the aggregate of all fans as a single sensor; per-fan discrimination is reserved for a future release.
contents.comment: Validation: v >= 0 RPM; reject NaN / +-Inf; null/suppressed on unsupported hosts. v == 0 while Temperature is climbing is the canonical fan-failure signature. (DTDL v2 has no semantic type for RPM; treat as plain double.)
